newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philrealty says buys back own shares.
newsitem.headline: Philrealty says buys back own shares.

text.p: Philippine Realty & Holdings Corp (Philrealty) said on Friday it had bought back 53.521 million of its shares in the stock market at a total price of 71.563 million pesos, or about 1.34 pesos per share.

Executive vice president Amador Bacani told Reuters the company had allocated 250 million pesos for the buyback programme. The initial purchases were done late last week. Philrealty is currently trading at 1.34 pesos, up two centavos from Thursday's close.

"We believe that the stock is currently undervalued," Bacani said. He said the book value of the stock is estimated at 1.40 pesos. The company has about 25 percent of its outstanding shares being traded in the market.
